```artifact
Feature: Doctor and Chemist/Lab Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
  Given a system with no doctors
  When I add a new doctor with a unique name, age, sex, qualification, experience, and speciality
  Then the doctor should be added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Add a new doctor with varying details
  | Name       | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
  | "<Name>"  | "<Age>" | "<Sex>" | "<Qualification>" | "<Experience>" | "<Speciality>" |

  Examples:
  | John Doe | 35  | M   | MD            | 10        | Cardiology  |
  | Jane Smith| 40  | F   | PhD           | 5         | Neurology   |

  Scenario: View and update doctor details
  Given a system with existing doctors
  When I view and update a doctor's details
  Then the doctor's details should be updated

  Scenario Outline: View and update doctor details with varying speciality
  | Name       | Speciality |
  | "<Name>"  | "<Speciality>" |

  Examples:
  | John Doe | Cardiology  |
  | Jane Smith| Neurology   |

  Scenario: Delete a doctor
  Given a system with existing doctors and pending consultations
  When I delete a doctor
  Then the doctor should be deleted if no new consultations are pending

  Scenario Outline: Delete a doctor with varying conditions
  | Name       | Consultations |
  | "<Name>"  | "<Consultations>" |

  Examples:
  | John Doe | None         |
  | Jane Smith| Pending      |


  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
  Given a system with no chemists or labs
  When I add a new chemist or lab with a unique pincode
  Then the chemist or lab should be added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Add a new chemist or lab with varying pincode
  | Pincode    |
  | "<Pincode>" |

  Examples:
  | 12345      | 67890       |

  Scenario: View and update chemist/lab details
  Given a system with existing chemists or labs
  When I view and update a chemist or lab's details
  Then the chemist or lab's details should be updated

  Scenario Outline: View and update chemist/lab details with varying pincode
  | Pincode    |
  | "<Pincode>" |

  Examples:
  | 67890       | 12345       |

  Scenario: Delete a chemist or lab
  Given a system with existing chemists or labs and pending prescriptions
  When I delete a chemist or lab
  Then the chemist or lab should be deleted if no new prescriptions are pending

  Scenario Outline: Delete a chemist or lab with varying conditions
  | Pincode    | Prescriptions |
  | "<Pincode>" | "<Prescriptions>" |

  Examples:
  | 67890       | None         |
  | 12345       | Pending      |
```
